name: PC1: Model Hybridization
description: PC1 focuses on the hybridization and management of heterogeneous models within digital twins. The project addresses the challenge of combining physical models and data-based models through systematic approaches, interfaces, and operators.

name: PC2: Architecture & Interoperability
description: PC2 aims to establish a robust architectural framework and interoperability standards for digital twins, facilitating seamless integration and communication between diverse systems and models.

name: PC3: Methodology & Languages
description: PC3 focuses on the development of methodologies and languages for the specification, design, and implementation of digital twins, promoting best practices and reusability.

name: PC4: Digital Coupling
description: PC4 aims to enhance the digital coupling of physical and virtual systems within digital twins, ensuring accurate representation and interaction between real-world and digital entities.

name: PC5: Human Interactions
description: PC5 focuses on the integration of human interactions within digital twins, addressing the challenges of user experience, collaboration, and decision-making in complex environments.
